justification: Fix the DA-outcomes silent failure and wire determination outcomes plus council refusal counts into the Neighbourhood card. Root cause found by live probe: outFields requested DEVELOPMENT_TYPE but the layer's column is TYPE_OF_DEVELOPMENT, so ArcGIS errored and the empty-dict client response rendered as a silent zero for every query; the suspected LODGEMENT_DATE date filter was innocent (string field, lexicographic filter verified working). All queries now fail loudly; verified live: 38 outcomes near Concord, Canada Bay 992 determined / 45 refused over 8 years.

pre_impl.existing_data: services/da_outcome.py existed unwired (merged in the Tier-1 service PR); the live layer metadata was probed before any code change: 63 fields, LODGEMENT_DATE and ASSESMENT_RESULT are string-typed, DEVELOPMENT_TYPE and ZONE_DESC do not exist, supportsStatistics advertises true but the groupBy statistics query returns Unable to complete operation.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Three assumptions fell to the live probe: the suspected date-filter bug was innocent; the real killer was one wrong column name; and the statistics endpoint the old code and its tests relied on is rejected by the live server (the old tests mocked a response shape that can never occur — self-confirming). Also the tracking layer only backfills outcomes for applications lodged up to about 2022, so a 3-year refusal window held 4 records for a whole LGA — the brief uses an 8-year window with the period always displayed.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new source: this wires the existing da_outcome service through the established _safe_call/_timed_result/DataField pattern as new fields on the existing Neighbourhood section (kept separate from the recent-applications feed, which stays on the consolidated DB table). The refusal computation was rewritten from the rejected statistics query to three verified returnCountOnly queries.

functions.name: query_da_outcomes_near
functions.input: coordinates, radius and lookback window for the bbox query with Haversine post-filter
functions.output: DAOutcome rows with the recorded result, development type, stated cost and dates
functions.if_none: an empty-dict client response (any transport or ArcGIS failure) raises instead of returning [] — a failed query is never a silent zero determinations

functions.name: get_refusal_rate
functions.input: the LGA name (case-normalised against the layer's uppercase LGA_NAME) and the period in years
functions.output: RefusalStats with approved/refused/deferred counts, the total and the rate, via three returnCountOnly queries
functions.if_none: a missing count key raises so a refusal rate is never fabricated from a silently-zero count; zero determined rows returns None (a checked empty); a zone filter raises because the layer has no zone column

functions.name: _fetch_da_outcomes
functions.input: coordinates; radius and window from CONFIG so the UI states them from the payload
functions.output: the outcomes list wrapped with its radius_m and years_back
functions.if_none: raises through _safe_call to NOT_AVAILABLE with the reason — the card says the lookup did not complete

functions.name: _build_neighbourhood
functions.input: the DA feed plus the new outcomes and refusal DataFields from their timed fetches
functions.output: Neighbourhood with da_outcomes and da_refusal_stats in three distinct states
functions.if_none: not-queried (renovation path), failed, and queried-empty each carry their own reason and confidence — never conflated

values.value: radius_m and years_back inside the da_outcomes payload
values.if_missing: the frontend falls back to stating the configured defaults; the period and radius are always displayed with the counts

queries: N/A — ArcGIS REST queries only, all parameter-built with the layer's verified field names; no database queries

break_it.scenario: The tracking endpoint rate-limits or its circuit opens mid-brief
break_it.what_happens: The empty-dict response raises, _safe_call stamps NOT_AVAILABLE and the card says the outcomes lookup did not complete — before this fix the same condition rendered as zero nearby determinations at full confidence

break_it.scenario: A caller filters the refusal cohort by zone
break_it.what_happens: The layer has no zone column (verified live) — the old code silently zeroed the cohort; it now raises ValueError naming the limitation

break_it.scenario: A mixed-case council name (Canada Bay) is matched against the layer's uppercase LGA_NAME values
break_it.what_happens: UPPER() on both sides — verified live on all three demo LGAs (Canada Bay, Canterbury-Bankstown, Wingecarribee all return real counts)

break_it.scenario: The renovation (strata) path renders the Neighbourhood-less brief
break_it.what_happens: The outcome fields default to a distinct not-queried state — never an implied zero determinations for a lot we did not query
break_it.how: default DataFields on the Neighbourhood model plus the not-queried branch in _build_neighbourhood; test_neighbourhood_outcomes_not_queried_renders_distinctly

break_it.scenario: The outcome backfill gap makes a short refusal window meaningless
break_it.what_happens: The brief queries an 8-year window and the card always states the period and counts with the rate; the field hint notes the tracking data records outcomes mainly for applications lodged up to 2022
break_it.how: CONFIG.da_outcomes_years_back documented with the live finding; counts and period ride inside the payload
break_it.repro: run the brief for 14 Stanley St Concord and open the Neighbourhood card

post_merge.other_repo: none — new Neighbourhood fields pass through the Trigger.dev relay transparently
post_merge.manual_verify: after Railway deploys, run the brief for 14 Stanley St Concord: Neighbourhood shows determined applications within 200 m and the Canada Bay counts (992 determined, 45 refused, 4.5% over 8 years at capture time)
